# ErikrafT AI

> ErikrafT AI is an open-source web app with Portuguese (Brazil) and English interfaces, Firebase Authentication, and usage limits. It offers FLUX text → image and an experimental Qwythos image → text → image flow. In Qwythos mode, reference images the browser can decode are normalized to JPEG and uploaded to the Hugging Face Space for inference.

- Website: https://ai.erikraft.com/
- Source repository: https://github.com/erikraft/AI
- Privacy policy: https://ai.erikraft.com/privacy.html
- Terms of use: https://ai.erikraft.com/terms.html
- Website hosting: Cloudflare Workers + Static Assets. AI model inference runs in the Hugging Face Space.
- API readiness: the checked-in Cloudflare Worker currently responds HTTP 503 to POST /api/generate until its Firebase/Firestore/Hugging Face API route is implemented.
- Hugging Face Space (image backend): https://huggingface.co/spaces/ErikrafT/erikraft-ai
- Text-to-image model: aoxo/flux.1dev-abliterated
- Experimental image → text → image workflow: fluffy12222/Qwythos-9B-Claude-Mythos-5-1M-heretic-abliterated interprets an uploaded reference image and instructions into a text prompt; FLUX renders the final pixels in a separate GPU request.
- Qwythos is used for multimodal interpretation and returns a text prompt; FLUX is the renderer for final image pixels. End-to-end hardware/model compatibility still depends on Space runtime and provider quotas.
- Authentication providers: Google, GitHub, and email/password with verified email addresses.
- Availability and generation quotas depend on the site's rate limits and Hugging Face hardware/service limits.

- Legal and policy pages are general information and do not guarantee compliance with every jurisdiction or approval by any government service.

For project details, consult the README and source files in the GitHub repository.
